name: Roger Vieillard

said.q: This great artist had the modesty to devote a great deal of work to the color reproduction of a certain number of paintings by the greatest modern masters. But with what taste and what results! While most of the reproductions of paintings, whatever their fidelity, give only the most material aspect or the bark, Villon delivers the essence. An astonishing appropriateness in the work of the process and of the scale preserves its substance. Villon's reproductions remain unequaled in this field.
said.in: Les gravures de Jacques Villon, Jardin des Arts, n° 55, May 1959
